serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#bot.Expression.Sad
Bot: Where were you?! I was worried sick! 
You: This and that happened, but I’m fine. I promise. 
Bot: You should go to a hospital. I don’t know what’s going on, but your vitals are all over the place!
You: I will live. 
#bot.Expression.Clear
#bot.Expression.Angry
Bot: Is that the fault of that clinic you were going to? Maybe I should go and pay them a visit!
#bot.Expression.Clear
#bot.Expression.Sad
You: No! It’s entirely my fault. I went too far. It won’t happen again. I promise…
Bot: Ok… {{wi}}Just, be careful, please…
I feel so bad…
I disappointed so many people and it could have ended even worse…
What was I thinking?!
I need to do better.
